liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Quotes lyrics about the end of Sugar Magnolia, tying it to the reviewer falling in love with Dead concerts [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **We Want Phil Chant**: back after 104 archived shows (555 days); rare: 3 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-12-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.85593.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 155 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound is very good once the malfunctioning ultrabox is turned off, around the second verse of Minglewood; Sound is perfect once the ultrabox is shut off about a minute into Minglewood; Once Healy's ultrabox is turned off at Minglewood, the recording takes shape [1][18][19][21]
- **gd1987-12-28.168488.ec7.ont.flac1644**: source not stated; 22 songs; 147 min [2]
- **gd87-12-28.sbd.samaritano.17280.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 151 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Reports the recording sounds warbly and distorted throughout; Reports a problem in the first couple of songs, improving by Far From Me [12][13]
- **gd87-12-28.sbd-audpatch.braverman.16910.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 150 min; rated 2.5/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Says no good soundboard exists for the first two tunes, so they are patched; the rest is fine soundboard; Patched opening songs from audience taping sound tinny and high-pitched; the rest is soundboard [14][16]
- **gd1987-12-28.163799.ultramatrix.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 152 min [5]. Said about its sound: Ultrabox feed had severe right-channel distortion in Feel Like A Stranger, Franklin's Tower and Minglewood, then ambient mics only briefly [5]
- **gd87-12-28.schoeps.ewing.16585.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [9]. Said about its sound: Patched opening songs from audience taping sound tinny and high-pitched; the rest is soundboard [17]

## Around the show

- Enjoys hearing the band's between-song conversation and joking on the pure soundboard [18]
- Taper recorded this and the previous night at the Oakland Coliseum Arena, second time there after December 17 1986 [2]
- Taper's 1986 Coliseum visit involved trouble with his '67 VW bus, similar to a Ventura Fairgrounds 1986 mishap [2]
- Attended the show; found it solid but says the 12/27 show was the best of the run [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-12-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.85593.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [1]. Also: Two different soundboard cassette masters were combined seamlessly, from tapes by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [1]
- **gd1987-12-28.168488.ec7.ont.flac1644**: taped by OldNeumanntapr; transferred by OldNeumanntapr; source: OTS; Superscope EC-7 Cardioid Condensers (Near Coincident) >Sony TC-153SD [XLIIS] [2]. Also: Recorded with Superscope EC7 microphones running on AA batteries; the taper had to buy batteries from another taper [2]
- **gd87-12-28.sbd.samaritano.17280.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Cassette Soundboard (Gans)->DAT->ZA2->SoundForge->SHN. *No* audience patch. Low generation lineage guaranteed. See info file for details. SHN'd and… [3]. Also: Joe Samaritano converted to SHN and seeded it to etree; described as low generation [3]
- **gd87-12-28.sbd-audpatch.braverman.16910.sbeok.shnf**: source: Ultramatrix (soundboard/audience mix) Master Cassette> DAT> CD> SHN patched with FOB Schoeps [4]. Also: Says the first two songs are patched from an audience recording, and the full show is present despite incomplete description [16]
- **gd1987-12-28.163799.ultramatrix.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Joani Walker's Master Ultramatrix Soundboard Cassettes (TDK MA-XG90) [5]
- **gd87-12-28.schoeps.ewing.16585.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps FOB->PCM->DAT->CD->CD->WAV->SHN via "M.D." encoded by Curtis Ewing [9]. Also: Says the first two songs are patched from an audience recording, and the full show is present despite incomplete description [17]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-12-31 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-12-31-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 28, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/december-28-1987) [24]
